acceptanceCriteria: make go-archive-gate passes on a tree whose ls-tree listing exceeds 1 MiB
subprocess output stays bounded: a listing above the new cap is still refused with subprocess-output-limit
any related bound (archive report, framing allowance) that scales with path count is checked and adjusted or recorded
body: CI artifact-integrity (make go-archive-gate) failed on PRs beamfall/corvint#1094 and #1100 on 2026-10-18 with `release-artifact-v0 archive: git ls-tree -r -z --full-tree <sha>: subprocess-output-limit`. conformance/release-artifact-v0/archive_process.go:12 sets maximumCommandOutput = 1 << 20 (1,048,576). Measured `git ls-tree -r -z --full-tree` sizes: origin/main 2ab0e7442 = 1,044,510 bytes (99.6% of cap); sta-batch 126517da4 = 1,048,827 (over). Any PR adding a few dozen paths now fails the gate. Expected: the gate bounds subprocess output with headroom proportional to repository size, or streams the listing. Actual: hard 1 MiB cap reached by ordinary growth. Fix in progress on branch claude/archive-output-cap.
title: go-archive-gate fails with subprocess-output-limit: git ls-tree listing outgrew the 1 MiB maximumCommandOutput cap
